description: This file contains acceptance tests for the AOK_KnowledgeBase module within the SuiteCRM project. It utilizes the Codeception testing framework to verify viewing and creation functionalities of the Knowledge Base module.

classes.name: AOK_KnowledgeBaseCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the KnowledgeBase module, covering viewing and creation scenarios.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize fake data generator and seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewKnowledgeBaseModule
methods.description: Test that verifies the Knowledge Base module view for an admin user.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Test that verifies the creation of a new Knowledge Base entry by an admin user.
